list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, website_id::text AS __value FROM website WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*)::float / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT session_id), 0) AS value FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 1) AS pageviews, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT url_path AS path, count(*) AS views, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY url_path ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT coalesce(NULLIF(referrer_domain, ''), '(direct)') AS referrer, count(*) AS views, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT event_name, count(*) AS hits, count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM website_event WHERE website_id = '$site'::uuid AND event_type = 2 AND event_name IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT coalesce(s.country, '??') AS country, count(DISTINCT we.session_id) AS sessions FROM website_event we JOIN session s ON s.session_id = we.session_id WHERE we.website_id = '$site'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(we.created_at) GROUP BY country ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 25
